Tell us about your current games!

I've been running a solo 5e campaign for my fianceé who's never played before. She's been playing a wizard scam artist and its been going pretty well! I'm also gearing up to start a West Marches Campaign. I'm pretty excited about it and have been busying making dungeons, random encounter tables, and a map for this past week.

I don't actually have a game running just yet, but I am working on one. The basic premise is that the PCs are the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse, they just don't know it yet. I'm still working out the details, but there's basically a lot of outsider subterfuge going on, as not everyone agrees that it's the right time to reset the world. The players will solve a few puzzles which turn out to be rituals that unlock hidden Horsemen powers, while dealing with the plots and plans of various celestial, infernal, and abyssal agents, not to mentaion the gods themselves who want the world to end. I've got it set to run from first to fifteenth level, then starts the next campaign, where they have to survive a total war of the outer planes.

I'm currently DMing a game in a custom universe where the PCs witnessed an attempted poisoning on a government official, a crime that was not solved, and then kept quiet about it for ten years. Last night, they freely discussed the event in a trial for the murder of the same official, and were promptly arrested for treason.

We are currently about to wrap up our current campaign. We have been summoned to a magical island by the bbeg. The island is mostly magical we have had to fight our way through arena's, magical forests that come to life with illusions, lots of magical transportation lights and general monster fights to get access to his lair.

It is a zombie survival-like campaign with heavy focus on undead. Currently only four sessions in but we seem to have gotten ourselves surrounded by a ridiculously large force of undead in the capital city (maybe the capital?   • The arrival of an allied fleet to help break the siege.

  • A hostile naval blockade which lost a ship recently and will probably lose more.

  • A rampaging behemoth of a zombie.

  • Some crazy intelligent undead that is purposefully desecrating temples to the gods.
